import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, flow;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, int f) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; flow = f;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level, ptr;

        Dinic(int n) {
            N = n;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int d, int c) {
            edges.add(new Edge(s, d, c, 0));
            edges.add(new Edge(d, s, 0, 0));
            adj.get(s).add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj.get(d).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            level[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (level[e.dst] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                        level[e.dst] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int flow, int t) {
            if (flow == 0 || u == t) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                int idx = adj.get(u).get(i);
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (level[e.dst] != level[u] + 1) continue;
                int pushed = dfs(e.dst, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow), t);
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, Integer.MAX_VALUE, t);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static String[] a, b;
    static int[][] dist1, dist2;
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static boolean inBounds(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++)
                dist1[i][j] = (int)1e9;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist1[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && dist1[nx][ny] == (int)1e9 && b[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    dist1[nx][ny] = dist1[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++)
                dist2[i][j] = (int)1e9;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist2[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            if (dist2[x][y] >= dist1[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && dist2[nx][ny] == (int)1e9 && a[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && dist2[x][y] + 1 <= dist1[nx][ny]) {
                    dist2[nx][ny] = dist2[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        a = new String[n];
        b = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    b[i] = b[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + b[i].substring(j + 1);
                    a[i] = a[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + a[i].substring(j + 1);
                    i = n;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Y' && a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        dist1 = new int[30][30];
        dist2 = new int[30][30];
        bfs1(zx, zy);

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(n * n * 2 + 5);
        int src = 0, dst = 2 * n * n + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int u = i * n + j + 1;
                int v = n * n + u;
                dinic.addEdge(src, u, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                dinic.addEdge(v, dst, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                bfs2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                        if (b[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || dist2[x][y] > t) continue;
                        dinic.addEdge(u, n * n + x * n + y + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(src, dst));
    }
}
